criteria.description: Compatible simple issues: Preserve title-only creation, legacy signed issues, comments and human-readable list/show with stable opening identity.
criteria.notes: Await integrated candidate and independent review evidence; baseline tests do not establish this requirement.

criteria.description: Optional rich state: Support title, description, criteria with stable local IDs, labels, assignees, open/closed status and namespaced string metadata; round-trip without loss.
criteria.notes: Await integrated candidate and independent review evidence; baseline tests do not establish this requirement.

criteria.description: Immutable revisions: Edits append signed full-state revisions referencing the stable issue and predecessor revisions; retain inspectable history and author attribution.
criteria.notes: Await integrated candidate and independent review evidence; baseline tests do not establish this requirement.

criteria.description: Conflict preservation: Compute all current heads; unresolved issues expose each head and no authoritative single state; do not use timestamps to resolve concurrent edits.
criteria.notes: Await integrated candidate and independent review evidence; baseline tests do not establish this requirement.

criteria.description: Guarded edit and resolution: Local edits require the exact observed head; ordinary resolution requires the complete observed head set; explicit staged resolution names current parents and validates its observed snapshot, preserving unconsumed heads. Stale requests append nothing. Distributed races remain explicit conflicts.
criteria.notes: Await integrated candidate and independent review evidence; baseline tests do not establish this requirement.

criteria.description: Typed relationships: Support blocks, related and parent links using full issue IDs; reject self/missing targets on local writes; expose incoming/outgoing links and diagnose blocks/parent cycles, including after sync.
criteria.notes: Await integrated candidate and independent review evidence; baseline tests do not establish this requirement.

criteria.description: Reliable operation replay: Optional actor-scoped operation IDs on create, revise/resolve and comment return the original event for identical requests; divergent key reuse fails without a write.
criteria.notes: Await integrated candidate and independent review evidence; baseline tests do not establish this requirement.

criteria.description: Machine interface: Document JSON input and versioned JSON output for issue mutation/query, full IDs, typed stable errors and nonzero failure exit. Machine mode emits no human prose on stdout.
criteria.notes: Await integrated candidate and independent review evidence; baseline tests do not establish this requirement.

criteria.description: Bounded navigation: List, heads, history and graph offer deterministic bounded pages and snapshot-aware continuation; reject stale continuations rather than silently skip work.
criteria.notes: Await integrated candidate and independent review evidence; baseline tests do not establish this requirement.

criteria.description: Verified read model: Derive the issue catalog, revision heads, comments and graph from verified signed histories; rebuild produces identical results and never depends on an authoritative cache.
criteria.notes: Await integrated candidate and independent review evidence; baseline tests do not establish this requirement.

criteria.description: General consumer example: Ship a runnable public-CLI consumer example/test demonstrating read/update/replay/stale rejection with no Go Kitty runtime dependency.
criteria.notes: Await integrated candidate and independent review evidence; baseline tests do not establish this requirement.

criteria.description: Discoverable behavior: Update CLI help and current protocol/user documentation together with tested ordinary-user and conflict-recovery examples.
criteria.notes: Await integrated candidate and independent review evidence; baseline tests do not establish this requirement.

criteria.description: Bounded inputs and outputs: New JSON request inputs are at most 256 KiB; page size defaults to 50 and caps at 200; field, graph and traversal bounds are documented and enforced before append.
criteria.notes: Await integrated candidate and independent review evidence; baseline tests do not establish this requirement.

criteria.description: Efficient verified reads: Reading a 1000-issue fixture must use batched event-object access without per-event Git subprocesses; measure duration and process counts, and verify semantic equality with the existing loader.
criteria.notes: Await integrated candidate and independent review evidence; baseline tests do not establish this requirement.

criteria.description: Regression evidence: Formatting, go test -race ./..., go vet ./..., go build ./..., and git diff --check pass for the integrated candidate; black-box tests include two-replica conflicts and replay failure boundaries.
criteria.notes: Await integrated candidate and independent review evidence; baseline tests do not establish this requirement.

criteria.description: Repository authority: Signed Git histories remain the only durable authority; no mandatory service, database or third-party dependency.
criteria.notes: Await integrated candidate and independent review evidence; baseline tests do not establish this requirement.

criteria.description: Consumer independence: Issue status, assignment, criteria and metadata are descriptive; no Go Kitty leases, execution authorization, review acceptance or integration authority. No Beads cutover in this mission.
criteria.notes: Await integrated candidate and independent review evidence; baseline tests do not establish this requirement.

criteria.description: Compatibility and scope: Preserve hn namespaces, existing signed bytes, proposal/CI/identity/replication/memory behavior and unrelated historical work. No web UI or new sync protocol.
criteria.notes: Await integrated candidate and independent review evidence; baseline tests do not establish this requirement.
